stories.title: U.S., Israel may attack Iran post-elections. And, SpaceX and Tesla consider merging
stories.description: The U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible post-elections attack on Iran, an anonymous source tells NPR. And, Elon Musk considers merging his companies SpaceX and Tesla.

stories.title: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, source tells NPR
stories.description: The U.S. and Israel are preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran in early November, after the U.S. midterm elections, a person briefed on war planning told NPR. Iran said it is prepared.

stories.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
stories.description: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom.

stories.title: US orders some diplomats to leave Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate
stories.description: The warning to US officials comes as at least three people die in the latest strikes at an airport and an oil field.

stories.title: UK to deploy jets to defend Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
stories.description: The UK announces it will provide additional defensive military support to Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks escalate in the region.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 73 security recruits, local authorities say
stories.description: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province on Monday that was being used as a training centre, Yemen's army says.

stories.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says
stories.description: Yemen's information minister says the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.

stories.title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
stories.description: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.

stories.title: Yemenis face severe shortages in Taiz amid Houthi blockade
stories.description: Residents in Yemen’s Taiz are facing severe food and water shortages as a Houthi blockade cuts off a key supply route.

stories.title: Iran reveals ‘offensive’ doctrine, US issues alert: Is war imminent?
stories.description: US orders diplomatic staff out of Saudi Arabia amid escalating conflict and reports of potential US strikes on Iran.

stories.title: Fighting rages in Yemen’s Taiz as UN warns nearly 260,000 displaced
stories.description: Yemen's government forces launched hundreds of strikes on Houthi locations, a spokesperson says.

stories.title: Can Russia broker a new US-Iran deal?
stories.description: Russia’s nuclear expertise, close ties with Tehran and negotiation experience could give Moscow an edge as a mediator.

stories.description: Washington’s envoy Steve Witkoff arrived in Saint Petersburg early Wednesday to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin following what US Secretary of State Marco Rubio described as “positive” talks with President Volodymyr Zelensky of Ukraine. stories.description: WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump called upon Ukraine on Tuesday to make a deal to settle the war with Russia, saying Moscow wanted to end the conflict. “Ukraine has to want to settle this war,” Trump told reporters in the Oval Office. stories.description: PARIS: The oversight board for social media giant Meta said on Tuesday it found “recurrent enforcement failures” in content moderation related to the US midterm elections and Brazil’s presidential election. stories.title: Yemen’s Houthis say they attacked Saudi Defence Ministry, Aramco in Yanbu and Dammam airport
stories.description: Saudi Arabia’s Energy Ministry said on Wednesday (October 21, 2026) that debris from an intercepted drone killed two people and injured two others at an Aramco-operated oil field in the country’s southeast.

stories.title: Iran says 7 oil tankers catch fire or damaged overnight in Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: Iran’s state television reported that seven oil tankers have caught fire and were damaged overnight Thursday (October 22, 2026) after being targeted or striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz

stories.title: Yemen’s Houthis say targeted Saudi position in Aden
stories.description: The Houthis also targeted a military base at an airport in the southern city of Al Mukalla

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron lands in Riyadh on surprise ‘solidarity’ visit
stories.description: Emmanuel Macron is the first Western leader to visit the kingdom since Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis intensified their attacks this month.

stories.title: Albanian police clash with anti-government protesters for eighth day
stories.description: Prime Minister Edi Rama called it “a hybrid war” and accused protesters of holding Tirana “under a climate of terror,” as student demands over tuition fees merged with a broader anti-government movement

stories.title: Iran security chief rejects moving enriched uranium out of country
stories.description: "Not even a tiny bit of enriched nuclear material will leave Iran; such materials constitute a major asset and national wealth for the Iranian people, intended for use within the country," says Mr. Rezaei, Iran's secretary of the Supreme National Security Council

stories.title: EU grudgingly admits sanctions failed to cripple Russian economy — Polyansky
